data.one_liner: A comprehensive collection of Dart and Flutter extensions to reduce boilerplate code.
data.what_it_does: Provides a large suite of extensions for BuildContext, widgets, text styles, navigation, media queries, strings, lists, maps, and dates. Helps reduce repetitive code like MediaQuery lookups, navigator pushes, and padding/sizing wrappers.
use_when: You want to reduce boilerplate code for common Flutter patterns like MediaQuery, Navigator, and EdgeInsets.
You prefer fluent extension methods over wrapping widgets or calling static utility methods.
avoid_when: You prefer strict separation of concerns and want to avoid polluting global extension namespaces.
You only need a single isolated utility (e.g., just shimmers) and want to keep dependencies minimal.
strengths: Massive collection of convenient helper methods across almost all common Flutter types.
Includes responsive layout helpers, platform checks, and localized context shortcuts.
weaknesses: Pollutes global autocomplete scopes with a large number of extension methods.
Large surface area means you may only use a small fraction of the included extensions.
data.setup_notes: Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.
